messages.content: Rewrite in Victorian prose, style, manner, and tone.  "I don't want to set, the world on fire. I just want to start, a flame in your heart."  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content: To be clear, I must state my intent plainly. I do not wish to cause global conflagration or widespread ruin. My desire is singular and tender. I seek only to kindle a small, warm light within your chest. Let this gentle glow reside there. It shall serve as a beacon of affection. Pray, accept this modest offering.
